messages:
Ravi: quick design question: for scorecard bulk-approve, do we keep a destructive confirmation modal or rely on an inline undo snackbar? trying to balance speed for power users vs preventing accidental approvals. mock: https://figma.redwood/bulk-approve-v3 :thinking:
Nina: love the undo snackbar for flow speed. modal will cause friction when approving large runs. how often do people bulk-approve vs individual?
Joel: analytics: ~60% of approvals are bulk on runs >100 items. accidental approvals are rare (~0.3%) but high cost when they happen.
Priya: accessibility angle: snackbars must be announced by SR and focus should not be stolen from current context. undo needs aria-live polite message: "Approvals submitted. Undo".
Marcos: copy nit: instead of "Undo" maybe "Revert approvals"? "Undo" is shorter but might be ambiguous in conversation.
Ravi: can we do a hybrid? fast path = snackbar + undo for bulk <= 1k, but show a confirmation modal for very large runs or when tests contain blocked tags.
Nina: that seems reasonable. modal content should summarize what will change: "You are about to approve 4,320 items across 12 prompt sets. This will mark them as Approved and trigger downstream replays." include a clear bullet list.
Priya: modal accessibility checklist: trap focus, keyboard accessible, descriptive heading, and include an aria-describedby on the confirm button: "Approves all selected results and cannot be undone after snackbar expires." ensure color contrast for danger action meets 4.5:1.
Joel: implementation constraints: our backend bulk endpoint can handle 10k in one request but it's slower. maybe chunk and stream progress in the UI. If we chunk, undo complexity increases.
Marcos: UX suggestion: after bulk commit show a progress panel (non-modal) with counts and a 30s undo window. If admins cancel within 30s we reverse via an idempotent revert endpoint. If chunked, revert acts on committed chunks.
Ravi: timeline: can we ship snackbar + undo first, with modal gated behind a usage threshold? propose: rollout A: snackbar undo for all; monitor accidental rate. Rollout B: enable modal for >2k items + when any selected item has tag "blocked".
Nina: copy proposal for snackbar: "4,320 results approved. Undo". For modal confirm button: "Approve all results (4,320)" and secondary: "Cancel". Add smaller link: "View changes" to open the diff.
Priya: screenreader announcement example:

aria-live="polite": "4,320 results approved. Press Undo to revert."

Also speak number formatting for accessibility e.g., "four thousand three hundred twenty" if possible.
Joel: logging/telemetry: tag events with flow: bulk-approve-snackbar, bulk-approve-modal, bulk-revert. capture time-to-undo and number of items reverted.
Marcos: QA notes: test with keyboard-only, NVDA/VoiceOver, mobile widths, and with multi-select that includes mixed prompt-set owners (permissions check). confirm the snackbar doesn't disappear before SR announces it.
Ravi: action items: Nina will draft copy variants, Priya to write a11y acceptance criteria, Joel to add telemetry hooks and backend revert plan, Marcos owner for QA test plan. I'll start a short spike on chunked revert complexity. sync Friday 10am. :rocket:
